headword: {中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}
gloss: central plaza; central square; main courtyard

definitions.gloss: central plaza; central square; main courtyard
definitions.explanation: The main open public space in a town, building complex, park, or facility, often used as a gathering place.

examples.japanese: {中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}に{噴水|ふんすい}がある。
examples.english: There is a fountain in the central plaza.

examples.japanese: イベントは{駅|えき}の{中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}で{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The event will be held in the station's central square.

examples.japanese: {商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}の{中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}では{週末|しゅうまつ}ごとにミニコンサートが{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Mini concerts are held every weekend in the shopping complex's central plaza.

notes:
Composed of {中央|ちゅうおう} (central) and {広場|ひろば} (plaza, square, open space). Commonly used for both outdoor and indoor public gathering spaces. Many Japanese train stations, shopping malls, and parks have a space named {中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}で{集|あつ}まる — to gather at the central plaza
- {中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば}で{開催|かいさい}する — to hold (an event) at the central square
- {駅|えき}の{中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば} — the station's central plaza
- {公園|こうえん}の{中央広場|ちゅうおうひろば} — the park's central open area

RELATED TERMS:
- {広場|ひろば} — plaza, square, open space
- {ロータリー} — rotary, roundabout (often a circular area in front of stations)
- {コンコース} — concourse (passageway area in stations)
